privacyAndSovereignty.finding: EU geography/Data Zone semantics are stated, but exact regions, resources, provider-selected processing behaviour, recovery resources and lifecycle evidence remain unresolved owner inputs. No EU residency or provider no-training conclusion is asserted.

leastAuthority.finding: All six owner inputs, including provider data use and EU AI Act classification, are assigned to Accountable Azure Platform Owner. That role cannot by itself evidence legal classification, DPO/privacy disposition, source-use rights or provider terms.
leastAuthority.requiredBoundary: Split evidence ownership and approval across Azure Platform, DPO, General Counsel, AI Governance, Compliance and Source Owners as applicable; retain a platform validation step and fail closed until every accountable sign-off is bound.

rollbackAndAudit.finding: Several rollback methods say to remove outputs or restore prior IaC/parameter bytes without an explicit human execution authorisation, immutable-evidence preservation rule, append-only revision rule or path guard. This conflicts with the case's immutable review baseline and can destroy audit evidence or mutate a reviewed subject.
rollbackAndAudit.requiredBoundary: Use stop/disable and append-only forward correction; preserve all evidence; require a separately authorised execution record for destructive cleanup and bind exact paths and hashes.

commandsAndPaths.finding: Work-package commands use relative .\tests and .\app paths while the candidate does not state a working directory. The referenced files are under 5-coding-r4, so execution from the documented case or Phase 4 directory is ambiguous and can target a wrong or absent path.
commandsAndPaths.requiredBoundary: Declare the repository root and 5-coding-r4 working directory for each command, use LiteralPath/explicit path assertions, and retain a no-Azure-command assertion.

manifestTraceability.finding: The seven-file manifest contains only six path/hash pairs. It omits the AFF artifact role, phase/change-control metadata, model-plan revision, generation time and candidate status required by the operating artifact convention.
manifestTraceability.requiredBoundary: Add the required non-self-referential manifest metadata and roles in a new append-only candidate; do not edit this bound subject.
